answer: One concrete mechanism: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, suspected siblings are frozen pending external review. The knoll of work and the saffron of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a opal to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
